Container.Name: PokeTracker
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted Pokémon TCG collection tracker for your household. Track sets, variants, graded slabs and wishlists, with prices refreshed automatically in the background. Invite family members and share collections with read-only links. Updates install from Settings → System with one click.
First run: open the WebUI and enter the Setup token you set below (or, if left blank, the one printed in the container log) to create the owner account.
Container.Requires: Internet access on first run and for background price/set updates. A reverse proxy is optional, only needed for HTTPS outside your home network.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, backups, cached card images and installed updates. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Setup token
Config.Description: Optional. A phrase you will type in on first visit to create the owner account. Leave blank to use a random one from the container log.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. The address people use to reach PokéTracker, e.g. https://cards.example.com if it sits behind a reverse proxy. Used in invite and share links.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the data folder.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the data folder.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for scheduled jobs and logs.

Config.Name: Image cache (MB)
Config.Description: Disk space for cached card images.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers from a reverse proxy. Use a hop count (1 for one proxy) or leave false if you reach PokéTracker directly.

Config.Name: SQLite journal mode
Config.Description: wal for local disk (default). Set to delete only if /data is a network share (NFS/SMB), where WAL is unsafe.

Config.Name: Demo mode
Config.Description: Optional. Enables a read-only public demo that resets nightly. Do not use for personal data; leave at 0/unset for a normal instance.
